translations.literal: His great-grandfather Shenggong was versed in numerology and fled the turmoil to Shu.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Shenggong was versed in numerology and fled the turmoil to Shu.

sentences.zh: 父溫珪，事蜀王建為司天監，每為建占吉兇，小不中，輒加詰責。

translations.literal: His father Wengui served Shu's Wang Jian as Director of the Directorate of Astronomy; whenever he divined fortune and misfortune for Jian, if he missed slightly he was harshly rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: His father Wengui served Wang Jian of Shu as director of the directorate of astronomy; whenever he divined good or ill fortune for Jian, the slightest error brought harsh rebuke.

sentences.zh: 溫珪臨卒，戒其子孫曰：「數術，吾世業，然吾仕亂國，得罪而幾死者數矣！

translations.literal: On his deathbed Wengui admonished his sons and grandsons: "Numerology is our family profession, yet I served a chaotic state and several times nearly died for my offenses!
translations.idiomatic: On his deathbed Wengui admonished his descendants: "Numerology is our family trade, yet I served a chaotic state and several times nearly died for it!

sentences.zh: 子孫能以佗道仕進者，不必為也。

translations.literal: If descendants can advance through office by another path, they need not do this.
translations.idiomatic: If my descendants can advance by another path, they need not follow this trade.

sentences.zh: 」然延義少亦以此仕蜀為司天監。

translations.literal: " Yet Yanyi in youth also entered office by this art and served Shu as Director of the Directorate of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: " Yet Yanyi in youth also entered office through this art and served Shu as director of the directorate of astronomy.

sentences.zh: 蜀亡，仕唐為星官。

translations.literal: When Shu perished he served Tang as an astral official.
translations.idiomatic: When Shu fell he served the Tang as an astral official.

sentences.zh: 延義兼通三式，頗善相人。

translations.literal: Yanyi was also versed in the Three Styles and quite skilled at physiognomy.
translations.idiomatic: Yanyi was also versed in the Three Styles and skilled at physiognomy.

sentences.zh: 契丹滅晉，延義隨虜至鎮州。

translations.literal: When the Khitan destroyed Jin, Yanyi followed the captives to Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan destroyed Jin, Yanyi followed the captives to Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 李筠、白再榮謀逐麻答歸漢，猶豫未決，延義假述數術贊成之。

translations.literal: Li Yun and Bai Zairong plotted to drive out Mada and return to Han; they hesitated and could not decide; Yanyi under pretense of numerology urged them to consent.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yun and Bai Zairong plotted to drive out Mada and return to the Han court; they hesitated; Yanyi, feigning divination, urged them to act.

sentences.zh: 周太祖自魏以兵入京師，太祖召延義問：「漢祚短促者，天數邪？

translations.literal: When Zhou Taizu entered the capital with troops from Wei, Taizu summoned Yanyi and asked: "Was the brevity of Han's mandate due to Heaven's number?
translations.idiomatic: When Later Zhou Taizu marched into the capital from Wei, he summoned Yanyi and asked, "Was the brevity of the Han mandate due to Heaven's decree?

sentences.zh: 」延義言：「王者撫天下，當以仁恩德澤，而漢法深酷，刑罰枉濫，天下稱冤，此其所以亡也！

translations.literal: " Yanyi said: "A king who pacifies the realm should use benevolence, grace, and virtue; yet Han law was harsh and cruel, punishments were wrongly applied, and the realm cried out in grievance—this is why it perished!
translations.idiomatic: " Yanyi said, "A king who rules the realm should govern with benevolence and grace; but Han law was harsh and cruel, punishments were wrongly applied, and the realm cried out in grievance—that is why it perished!

sentences.zh: 」是時，太祖方以兵圍蘇逢吉、劉銖第，欲誅其族，聞延義言悚然，因貸其族，二家獲全。

translations.literal: " At that time Taizu was just then using troops to besiege the residences of Su Fengji and Liu Chu, wishing to execute their clans; hearing Yanyi's words he was startled and therefore pardoned their clans; the two families were preserved whole.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Taizu was besieging the residences of Su Fengji and Liu Chu, intending to execute their clans; hearing Yanyi's words he was startled, pardoned their families, and both households were spared.

sentences.zh: 延義事周為太府卿、判司天監，以疾卒。

translations.literal: Yanyi served Zhou as Director of the Imperial Storehouse and provisional Director of the Directorate of Astronomy; he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Yanyi served Zhou as director of the imperial storehouse and provisional director of the directorate of astronomy; he died of illness.
